name: create_item
description: Create a new item on any LifeOS screen - bills, obligations, insurance, properties, maintenance, health, documents

parameters.name: screen
parameters.description: Screen name: bills, obligations, insurance, properties, maintenance, health, documents

parameters.name: bill_type
parameters.description: Bills only: electricity, mobile, internet, credit_card, water, gas, other

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Bills/Insurance: provider name (e.g. MSEB, HDFC, Bajaj)

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description: Bills: upi_gpay, credit_card, net_banking, auto_pay, cash

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Bills/Obligations/Maintenance: monthly, quarterly, half_yearly, yearly, one_time

parameters.name: policy_type
parameters.description: Insurance: health, life, car, home, travel, pet

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Properties only: residential, commercial, farmhouse, plot, shop

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Maintenance ONLY: type of maintenance (ac_service, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, painting, pest_control, general). If not provided, it is auto-derived from the title.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Maintenance: title (e.g. AC Service, Roof Repair, Kitchen Tap Fix)

parameters.name: member_relationship
parameters.description: Health: self, spouse, child, parent, dependent

parameters.name: blood_group
parameters.description: Health: A+, A-, B+, B-, O+, O-, AB+, AB-
